title: Two-layer Couette flow, viscosity contrast (analytic)
description:
Steady shear flow of two stacked liquids in a periodic channel (x period 4 cells) between a fixed wall (y_lo) and a wall sliding at U along +x (y_hi): liquid 1 (mu1) fills 0 < y < H1, liquid 2 (mu2 = mu_ratio mu1) H1 < y < H, interface on a cell edge (H1 = 10, H = 20 cells). The lattice relaxation time differs per cell (tau = 1 in the more viscous liquid, 0.5 + 0.5 / mu_ratio in the other).
Analytic: the shear stress is uniform, tau_s = U / (H1 / mu1 + H2 / mu2); u_x = tau_s y / mu1 below the interface, U - tau_s (H - y) / mu2 above (piecewise linear, kink at y = H1).
Derived values tab: tau_lower / tau_upper = mu times the least-squares slope of u_x over the cell centres of each layer (mean of u_x (y - y_c) x 12 / (H_i^2 - dx^2)), u_lower_mean / u_upper_mean = layer means of u_x (their centre values), u_below_interface = probe in the last cell of liquid 1. With the interface on a cell edge the TRT lattice reproduces the kink exactly at linear order (a linearised steady-state analysis of the D2Q9 populations gives the exact half-cell velocity jumps on both sides), so all agree to the float32 steady-state floor (~1e-5..1e-4); tolerance 1e-3, below the ~1 % of an interface off by half a cell at mu_ratio 8.
Line profile tab: u_profile across the channel at the last sweep value (mu_ratio 8) with the dashed piecewise-linear profile.
Sweep tab: tau_lower and u_below_interface versus mu_ratio (1..8; 1 = plain Couette) with the dashed closed forms.

parameters.name: mu_1
parameters.description: viscosity of the lower liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: mu_2
parameters.description: viscosity of the upper liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: rho_f
parameters.description: density of both liquids in kg/m^3

parameters.name: H_1
parameters.description: lower layer thickness (interface on a cell edge)

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: length of the periodic cell along x (the flow is uniform in x)

parameters.name: U_wall
parameters.description: speed of the upper wall along +x in m/s

parameters.name: y_probe
parameters.description: probe height: centre of the last lower-layer cell

analytic_curves.name: u_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(y < H_1, tau_ref*y/mu_1, U_wall - tau_ref*(H_ch - y)/mu_2)
